name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: Plain-English public financial education and fictional accounting checks with evidence-first stories, safe calculations and optional micro-lessons; local MCP prototype is not deployed.

interface.longDescription: Understand company finance in plain language, check arithmetic of public/synthetic figures and create source-labeled story cards and micro-lessons. Includes original finance/accounting skills and a separate local MCP reference implementation; does not include a connected live SEC, ERP, bank or market-data MCP server. It cannot independently certify public statements, audit SOX, offer investment advice or promise accuracy on uninspected sources. No confidential, personal or licensed-restricted uploads.
defaultPrompt: Explain profit versus cash flow in 30 seconds with a fictional example.
Check this public company revenue claim and disclose which source you inspected.
Create three accurate, source-labeled story cards about revenue growth.
